text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Tonight's celestial show.
If I'm at my usual spot, I can take my time...)

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
This is that 'hidden gem' that went viral!?
There are tons of people here. The power of the internet is nuts~

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, say the line~!
I'll start with 'The stars are so pretty tonight~.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega was thoroughly fed up
with the noisy night...
